post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: Final outcome of the call. booked = a new appointment was booked; rescheduled = an existing appointment was moved; cancelled = an appointment was cancelled; confirmed = an appointment was confirmed; transferred = the caller was handed to a staff member; info_only = only questions were answered; queued = the request was sent to the front-desk queue; voicemail = the call reached voicemail.

post_call_analysis_data.name: phi_beyond_scheduling_mentioned
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller volunteered health information beyond scheduling (a diagnosis, symptoms, medications, treatment details), asked about a balance or billing, gave a social security number or insurance member id, or asked about another person's appointment. False for ordinary booking, name, date of birth and phone number.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_opt_in_given
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller was asked the text-reminder opt-in question and clearly answered yes. False if not asked, declined, or unclear.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_opt_out_requested
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller said they do not want text messages or asked to stop receiving texts at any point in the call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_day
post_call_analysis_data.description: Spoken day of the booked or rescheduled appointment, e.g. Tuesday the 16th. Empty if none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: Spoken time of the booked or rescheduled appointment, e.g. 2:40 PM. Empty if none.
